results.text: 「Regular copies are five hundred yen. The rare one... has the sort of signature where she scribbled something in hiragana, so bidding starts at ten thousand. The last signed one with a cat doodle went for a hundred thousand, though.」

results.text: 「She graciously allowed the boys' synchronized swimming club--all two members of it--to operate despite school regulations. When a teacher complained, she drove him off by declaring, 'I gave them permission, so it is fine.'」

results.text: 「Oh, there are plenty. While the track team, karate club, and everyone else are working their butts off, we saunter home without a care. Then we get there, and suddenly a thought crosses our minds.」
